what_this_inventory_is_not: It is not the final THS-6 evidence pack.
It is not a gate report; no gate was evaluated by writing it.
It is not signed, and nothing in it may be signed until the work each attestation names has actually been done.
It does not make any claim about clinical validity.
why_not_final: WP-C12 has not happened. No external expert has reviewed any of this, so no correction loop has run, no revalidation has run, and no attestation exists to sign.
